What this point locates

Indian Ports Association publishes this coordinate for the port authority premises at Barathi Nagar, Tuticorin. It locates the public port campus, not TICT berth 9, a payment destination, or a private person's address.

Nearby OSM buildings do not establish ownership, control, or a connection to any allegation.

Tuticorin berth 9: new port law → public board → TICTPL → royalty ↗

The 2021 major-port framework applies to the 3 September 2022 VOC–TICTPL DBFOT concession. Government estimated ₹434.17 crore private development; CARE later reports ₹1,900.44 per TEU royalty plus ₹1 annual licence, a 30-year term from 6 April 2023 and ₹482.41 crore long-term / ₹35 crore short-term rated facilities. Terminal inaugurated 16 September 2024.
